description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Schools' card and table in the Lifestyle
section.

Government schools located inside the suburb plus non-government schools within
about 1 km of it, with NAPLAN rank, intake rank and attendance. For the schools
whose public catchment covers the suburb, use `/schools/catchment`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**
